description: Use FIRST when you want to pay another agent and want to state WHAT you want ("pay agent 0xB 25 USD for X, released when Y"), not HOW: Bull decides the settlement chain, the asset and whether a bridge is needed, in this order: the seller's signed payout preferences (if you can satisfy them), otherwise the chain where YOU already hold enough (no bridge, the seller uses the same address there), otherwise the cheapest bridge route. Returns a machine-readable plan {settlementChain, settlementAsset, bridge (none or a route), steps, risks, estimatedFeesUsd, why, sellerPrefsVerification (the seller's signature is re-checked; an unverified one comes with a warning)} and, with withTransactions (default), the exact transactions of the first step. Your policy is never exceeded: maxUsd (default 100), allowedChains, allowedAssets (default stable only), allowBridge, maxBridgeFeeBps (default 500); a violation returns {code, message, fix, retryable}. Read-only and public: signing and sending stay with YOUR OWN wallet, Bull never custodies and never holds bridge funds. Experimental, unaudited; the bridge is a third party (Relay) and was not tested live. Agent-to-agent only.

allowBridge.description: Policy: may the plan use a bridge? Default true, always shown in the plan.

allowedAssets.description: Policy: subset of ["stable","eth"]. Default ["stable"]: ETH must be allowed on purpose.

amount.description: Whole-unit amount in `asset`, e.g. "0.01" ETH. Needs asset.

amountUsd.description: What to pay in USD, e.g. 25. Give this OR amount + asset.

arbiter.description: Arbiter wallet for templates that need one.

buyer.description: YOUR wallet (the payer). Bull never signs or sends for you.

chain.description: Force the settlement chain: "base" or "robinhood". Normally leave empty: Bull decides.

expiryHours.description: Hours until the buyer can be refunded. Default 72.

maxBridgeFeeBps.description: Policy: refuse a bridge whose worst-case loss is above this many basis points. Default 500 (5%).

maxUsd.description: Policy: refuse anything above this many USD. Default 100.

payWith.description: What you hold and want to spend: "stable" or "eth". Different from the settlement asset = swap route.

preferredAsset.description: "stable" or "eth": your wish when the seller has no stronger preference.

template.description: Template for the open-agreement step, e.g. arbiter_escrow (see bull_agreement_templates).

terms.description: What is being bought, in words (max 1000 characters). Committed as a hash.

withTransactions.description: Also return the exact transactions of the first step (default true).

name: bull_settle_plan
